# Masab Farooque, Full Stack Engineer

> Masab Farooque is a full stack engineer based in Islamabad, Pakistan. He
> builds SaaS platforms, AI systems, data pipelines and full stack web
> applications end to end. 195 plus completed orders and 148 five star reviews
> from clients in 23 countries.

## Current work

- Chord.fm, Full Stack Engineer, June 2026 to present. Browser based audio and
  video editor for podcasters and creators. Built the Music Library panel from
  scratch, including waveform playback with click to seek. Backend written in Go
  on AWS Lambda with DynamoDB, API Gateway and S3.
- Skylight Studio, Full Stack Engineer, March 2026 to present. Next.js internal
  tooling platform for the Engineering Solutions team, including The Proposal
  Maker, an AI assisted tool that reads an RFP or email thread with Claude and
  drafts a branded proposal section by section.

## Background

Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, COMSATS University Islamabad, 2023.
Unity game developer at 10Static Studios and fellow at Mindstorm Studios from
2020 to 2023. Won Best Mechanics at the Rookie Game Jam 2022, The Hustler Award
at Epiphany Games in 2020, and placed runner up at Developers Game Jam 2.0.
Founded ReplayJutsu, a gaming publication that reached 100,000 monthly active
users. SEO Web Developer at PentaByteX from September 2024 to February 2025.
Web Developer at Fixels.nl from November 2025 to April 2026, where he shipped
Javea Denia Rentals and FirstDeal.nl.

He works solo, not as an agency. Every project is designed, built and deployed
by him.
